answer: Saffron-tagged cipher handshake. Each new identity must solve a per-epoch cipher challenge whose answer is bound to a saffron-tagged hardware root; agents only accept messages carrying a valid tag. Solving yields one jade token, spendable only after 30 days of continuous availability checks. Cloning forces the attacker to buy distinct hardware roots and idle them for the full month per clone, while each clone earns near-zero fees during idling, making marginal clones strictly negative-EV.
